full_prompt_en: A square, vividly colored illustration fills the entire frame with stylized birds, flowers, leaves, and small ornamental marks. The ground is saturated magenta, interrupted by dark navy patches that deepen the space behind the bright figures. Several birds overlap in a loose cluster. One at the upper left faces right, with a yellow beak, turquoise body, red wing, and a row of pale teardrop marks along its belly. Another near the upper center has a blue-and-black striped wing lifted high and a small yellow-orange eye. A lower bird turns left with a rounded blue body, pink head, patterned green wing, and yellow feet. A larger dark blue bird in the lower left wears dense curved lines of cyan, red, and yellow across its wing. Around them, upright plants rise from the bottom in repeated symmetrical stems. Pink, coral, and red flowers open as simple round or cup-shaped forms; narrow leaves and fronds alternate in turquoise, mustard, and deep blue. Small circular motifs and bright dots float between the larger shapes, ensuring that nearly every piece of the magenta field carries detail. Each bird is built from flat color compartments bounded by crisp dark lines, with short decorative strokes, scallops, spots, and stripes inside. Light is not modeled as natural illumination; brightness comes from saturated color placed against dark contours and the strong background. The composition is dense but readable because each body has a clear silhouette and its own directional pose. The whole image has the buoyant, handcrafted feeling of a folk-inspired print, with rhythmic repetition and playful visual abundance.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、色彩强烈的插画用几何化鸟、花、叶和小装饰笔痕填满整个画面。底色为饱和洋红，间有深海军蓝色块，使亮色形体后的空间更深。几只鸟松散地重叠在一起。左上方一只朝右，黄色鸟喙、青绿身体、红色翅膀，腹部排列一串浅色泪滴花纹。上方中央另一只有高举的蓝黑条纹翅膀和小小黄橙色眼睛。下方一只鸟转向左，圆润蓝身、粉红头、带纹样的绿色翅膀和黄脚。左下较大一只深蓝鸟，翅上布满青、红、黄的弯曲密线。它们周围，直立植物从底部升起，反复出现对称枝茎。粉、珊瑚红和红花以简单圆形或杯形开放；狭叶和羽状叶片在青绿、芥末黄和深蓝间交替。小圆纹和亮点漂在大形状之间，使洋红色底几乎处处都有细节。每只鸟都由清楚深色线条围成的扁平色格构造，内部填入短装饰线、扇贝纹、点和条纹。光并非自然主义塑形；亮度来自饱和色与暗轮廓、强底色的并置。构图密集却易读，因为每个身体都有清楚剪影和自身方向。整幅图有民间版画般轻快的手工感，带节奏重复与玩兴十足的视觉丰盛。
style_prompt_en: Colorful decorative illustration packs a flat field with crisp silhouettes, repeated plantlike stems, dots, circles, and patterned compartments. Saturated magenta, turquoise, cobalt, coral, yellow, and mustard are sharpened by dark navy outlines. Forms are flattened and filled with scallops, stripes, teardrops, and short curved marks rather than shaded volume. A dense all-over arrangement stays legible through varied scale and distinct directional shapes. Light is carried by color contrast and bright accents, not realistic cast shadow. The finish should feel hand-drawn and printlike, rhythmic, playful, and richly ornamented.
style_prompt_zh: 彩色装饰插画以清晰剪影、重复的植物状茎枝、圆点、圆形和花纹分格填满扁平色域。饱和洋红、青绿、钴蓝、珊瑚红、黄与芥末色由深海军蓝轮廓加强。形体被压平，内部用扇贝纹、条纹、泪滴和短弯线填充，而非用阴影塑造体积。全画面密集安排仍靠尺度变化和不同方向的形状保持可读。光感来自色彩反差和亮色重音，不来自真实投影。完成面应有手绘与版画质地，节奏鲜明、活泼而装饰丰厚。
theme_en: Colorful patterned birds among stylized flowers on a magenta ground
theme_zh: 洋红色底上，花丛间的彩色花纹鸟
name: Christopher Corr
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
